prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Building a Self-Adjusting College Football Predictive Model
We are looking to build a machine learning model to predict the outcomes of (American) college football games in terms of final score and likelihood that a team covers the spread from Vegas This model ideally would use machine learning so it would become more accurate over time as it inputs new information. There are multiple components to consider: 1) Extracting relevant data from source(s) using an ongoing API integration 2) Data storage and hosting 3) Machine learning modeling
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Telecom churn prediction
client: confidential
client_industry: telecom
start: 2021-01
end: 2021-03
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Python
- XGBoost
- pandas
- SHAP
- MLflow
built: A monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the
  retention team could read.
metrics:
- AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter
- top-decile lift 3.1x

title: Support ticket triage model
client: Kettlewell Support Co.
client_industry: SaaS
start: 2020-09
end: 2020-12
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- scikit-learn
- FastAPI
- Celery
- Redis
- PostgreSQL
built: A classifier that routes incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served by
  FastAPI, with nightly retraining run through a Celery worker on Redis.
metrics:
- macro-F1 0.88 vs 0.62 for the old keyword rules
- median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Telecom churn prediction (p02); Support ticket triage model (p01).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help build this self-adjusting college football predictive model.

I have extensive experience building machine learning systems in Python, including models that keep improving as new data comes in. In a Telecom churn prediction project (p02), I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read, and achieved an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter. In a Support ticket triage model (p01), I built a classifier that routed helpdesk tickets to 14 queues with nightly retraining, improving macro-F1 to 0.88.

For your project, I can help with the full pipeline: data extraction and ongoing API integration, storage/hosting, and the predictive modeling layer for score prediction and spread coverage.
